mapper.select:
select a.id assetId, a.name assetName, a.ip assetIp1, a.ip2 assetIp2, a.desk assetDesk, m.name deskName, o.id orgId, o.title orgName, t.id cabinetId, case when c.cabinet_id is not null then (t.name || ' ' || c.START_POSITION || '-' || c.END_POSITION || 'U') end cabinetName from asset a left join asset_mode m on a.desk = m.code left join asset_attach c on a.id = c.asset_id left join sys_org o on a.org_id = o.id left join room r on c.room_id = r.id left join cabinet t on c.cabinet_id = t.id where a.is_del = 1 and a.watch = 1 and a.id in
#{id}
